faqs.question: How often does a screw compressor need an oil change?
faqs.answer: Every 4,000 operating hours or once a year, whichever comes first. Use the oil grade named on the unit nameplate, and depressurise and isolate the unit before draining.

faqs.question: What happens after I raise a service case?
faqs.answer: You receive an acknowledgement with your case number. The case is routed to your regional queue, where a dispatcher assigns an engineer.

faqs.question: How do I know whether a visit is chargeable?
faqs.answer: It depends on the coverage plan for the unit. We check it before the engineer travels and tell you whether the plan is active, expired or missing.

faqs.question: Can I add details to a case I already raised?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reply to the acknowledgement email and your message is added to the same case, so the engineer sees the whole conversation in one place.
